CarnageOfFire.name: Carnage of Fire
CarnageOfFire.description: Generates volatile lava droplets. Molten projectiles detonate on impact, dealing area-of-effect damage to enemies within the blast radius.

DelusionOfZelkors.name: Delusion of Zelkors

BurningShield.name: Burning Shield
BurningShield.description: Conjures a blazing barrier that protects the caster and damages nearby foes. Creates a hazardous zone, deterring close-quarters engagement.

FireBeam.name: Fire Beam
FireBeam.description: Projects an intense beam of concentrated fire forward. Inflicts damage to enemies in its path, creating a linear zone of destruction.

DragonFlame.name: Dragon Flame

ChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
ChainLightning.description: Unleashes electrical energy that arcs between targets. Creates a chain reaction of lightning, damaging multiple enemies in rapid succession.

Spark.name: Spark
Spark.description: Generates electric sparks. Sparks leap between nearby adversaries, creating unpredictable patterns of electrical damage.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.description: Conjures a powerful wind vortex at the target location. Lifts and suspends enemies, dealing continuous damage from intense pressure and turbulent forces.

EyeOfTheStorm.name: Eye of the Storm
EyeOfTheStorm.description: Summons a localized maelstrom around the caster. Unleashes destructive forces on nearby enemies, combining violent winds and lightning.

FerocityOfWolves.name: Ferocity of Wolves
FerocityOfWolves.description: Manifests spectral wolves charged with electrical energy. Unleashes ethereal canines that materialize near the caster. Wolves lunge at nearby foes, delivering shocking assaults.

StaticCharge.name: Static Charge
StaticCharge.description: Transfers static charge to the ground. Creates an electrified field in the targeted area. Damages enemies who traverse the charged terrain.

StarBlades.name: Starblades
StarBlades.description: Invokes cosmic forces to manifest razor-sharp blades from the sky. Blades rain down and embed in the ground in a radial pattern, damaging nearby adversaries.

ElectricDragons.name: Electric Dragons
ElectricDragons.description: Manifests a ring of electric dragons around the caster. Dragons orbit the user, crackling with intense electrical energy. Inflicts damage to foes who come into contact with the ethereal serpents.

SpinningBlade.name: Spinning Blade
SpinningBlade.description: Conjures a rotating array of razor-sharp blades around the caster. Creates a mobile zone of cutting force, damaging enemies who venture too close.

PoisonCloud.name: Toxicity
PoisonCloud.description: Generates pools of poison around the caster. Creates hazardous zones on the ground that persist briefly. Damages enemies who come into contact with or traverse the toxic areas.

EnemyDeath.name: Death Blades
EnemyDeath.description: Manifests an ethereal blade imbued with arcane energy. Blade rotates, emitting waves of force that damage nearby foes.

ArcaneOrb.name: Arcane Orb
ArcaneOrb.description: Unleashes a homing orb of arcane energy. Orb phase-shifts through enemies, damaging them as it travels outward. On its return path, it continues to damage foes in its way back to the caster.

BloodDragons.name: Blood Dragons
BloodDragons.description: Summons ethereal blood dragons from thin air. Dragons surge towards foes, leaving trails of caustic mist that damage enemies.

ArcaneApocalypse.name: Arcane Apocalypse
ArcaneApocalypse.description: Unleashes chaotic bursts of reality-warping arcane energy. Creates multiple explosions, forming a sphere of otherworldly devastation around the battlefield.

FireAtom.name: Fire Orb
FireAtom.description: Conjures a pulsating orb on the ground. Orb accumulates charge over time, periodically releasing damaging waves of increasing intensity.

FieryTotem.name: Fiery Totem
FieryTotem.description: Manifests incendiary totems around the caster. Totems explode on contact, creating a tactical minefield of fiery eruptions.

ArcaneTotem.name: Arcane Totem
ArcaneTotem.description: Erects a mystical totem infused with arcane and primordial fire. Totem radiates waves of eldritch flame, searing nearby foes.

LightningTotem.name: Lightning Totem
LightningTotem.description: Erects an electrified totem channeling celestial lightning. Obelisk draws down lightning bolts, creating a field of electrical havoc around it.

ArcaneCrackedSeed.name: Kraken Seed
ArcaneCrackedSeed.description: Spawns a Kraken Seed near the target. Seeds appear in random locations around struck enemies, ready to unleash aquatic fury.

LightningPlasma.name: Lightning Plasma
LightningPlasma.description: Channels crackling lightning force through both arms. Emits damaging electrical energy to enemies on either side of the caster.
